title: Full Vehicle System
objective: Complete vehicle gameplay over MIB-14 definitions/rules while preserving existing vehicle, Asset, travel, Character, combat, economy and Project owners.

scope.purpose: Complete vehicle gameplay over MIB-14 definitions/rules.
scope.completion_gate: Representative vehicles support complete ownership/crew/travel/maintenance workflows across live and async play.

selection_boundaries: SMB-05 is completed_verified before SMB-06 implementation.
SMB-06 is the only authorized product-development work item for this attempt.

MIB-14 remains vehicle/platform/base configuration, compatibility, slot/cargo/power capacity, crew bounds, D17 mutation-intent and maintenance/repair/upgrade Project-request planning authority; SMB-06 composes those seams rather than replacing them.

D17 remains sole live Asset/vehicle identity, ownership, location, inventory/cargo placement, condition and state authority; SMB-06 may consume snapshots and committed owner-result references but may not directly mutate live truth.

Existing A8 shared-asset contracts retain vehicle operational-class/state vocabulary, station grants/command policy, vehicle resource projections and damage/capture transition semantics; SMB-06 may reference and orchestrate them without creating parallel ledgers.

KFR-05 remains operator-qualification projection authority and does not itself grant station permission or executable action authority; SMB-06 must require explicit station-grant/control evidence rather than infer control from qualification, ownership, possession or UI selection.

SMB-04/D28 remains journey/travel resolution authority and MIB-11/WCI remains world/navigation authority; SMB-06 may reference travel/navigation/resource consequence results and MIB-14 movement compatibility but may not create a second journey or World ledger.
Existing Action/Effect/combat owners, including A7/A8 seams, retain damage and combat-result authority; SMB-06 may expose explicit capability/result references only.

APW-03/D26 remains long-running Project/Activity and campaign-time authority, MIB-12 remains repair/upgrade/crafting definition authority, and MIB-13 remains current price/scarcity/settlement authority.
Fuel consumption, travel rates, damage values, repair costs, maintenance intervals, upgrade yields and system-resource deltas remain absent unless explicit owner definitions/results provide them.
Live/async continuity must be deterministic and checkpoint/replay based; no autonomous scheduler, unattended progress, wall-clock advancement or hidden authority shortcut is authorized.
Implementation must establish a causal failing acceptance seam before production code and pass exact-head Linux/Windows deterministic validation plus MIB-14, SMB-04 and KFR-05 predecessor invariants.
No provider activation, public/tester distribution, durable migration or unrelated refactor is authorized.
SMB-07 and later work remain unauthorized until SMB-06 is completed_verified and canonical state advances.

implementation_plan.name: RED acceptance seam
implementation_plan.deliverable: A focused profile that preserves MIB-14/SMB-04/KFR-05 invariants and fails specifically because the bounded SMB-06 full-vehicle workflow module does not yet exist.

implementation_plan.name: Derived vehicle workflow and replay contract
implementation_plan.deliverable: A deterministic non-authoritative vehicle workflow projection/replay covering explicit ownership, crew/station authorization and qualification references, D17 cargo references, A8 power/fuel resource references, SMB-04/D28 travel-result references, damage/combat result references, MIB-14 facilities/capabilities, maintenance/repair/upgrade Project references, and checkpointed live/async recovery without direct owner mutation.

implementation_plan.name: Source-governance proof
implementation_plan.deliverable: Machine-checkable proof that SMB-06 reuses MIB-14, D17, A8 vehicle/station/resource/damage contracts, KFR-05, SMB-04/D28, MIB-11/WCI, APW-03/D26, MIB-12, MIB-13 and existing combat owners without parallel ledgers, inferred formulas or autonomous progress.

implementation_plan.name: Exact-head verification and closeout
implementation_plan.deliverable: Linux and Windows focused acceptance, source-governance invariants, client typecheck and deterministic cross-platform receipts pass on one exact head before merge; then OPS3 records SMB-06 completed_verified and selects SMB-07 without starting it.

next_action: Create the SMB-06 RED acceptance test/profile on work/smb-06-full-vehicle-system, prove the expected focused failure after predecessor invariants pass, then implement only the minimum deterministic vehicle workflow/replay contract needed to satisfy the source-defined completion gate.
